summary_md: **nft//defi//OG⏰ 🔮 ([@opinion_bits](https://x.com/opinion_bits/status/2116238210393416066))** lists six open-source Claude Code mods that intercept tool calls, manage context or redraw the UI: Firstmate, fast-jev-compaction, terminal-browser, Agent Time Machine, TextFold and Context Attachment Manager, framing skills as knowledge, MCP as reach and mods as what happens around the agent ([kunchenguid/firstmate](https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate), [tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction](https://github.com/tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction), [zenbu-labs/terminal-browser](https://github.com/zenbu-labs/terminal-browser), [chenxiachan/textfold](https://github.com/chenxiachan/textfold)).
